contexts.text: The sword, the famine, and the pestilence () are the penalties of profanation.
The pestilence (; etc.) = a wasting away even to consumption.
Famines and pestilences () = no Knowledges of good and truth.
Lest He fall upon us with the pestilence and with the sword () = to avoid the damnation of evil and of falsity... Pestilence = the damnation of evil.
There are four kinds of vastations and punishments mentioned in the Word... and by the pestilence is signified the punishment of the evil which is not from falsity but from evil. Illustrated.
That by the pestilence is signified the punishment of evil, and its damnation. Illustrated.
The pestilence which creepeth in darkness () = the evil which is in secret. AC 7505:end.
That pestilence = evil, and the damnation of evil. Illustrated.
The sixth degree of their vastation is described by the pestilence (in .)

A pestilence exceeding grievous () = consumption in general. A pestilence = the vastation of truth; and, as it is called a pestilence exceeding grievous, there is signified the consumption of truth. That a pestilence = the vastation of truth. Illustrated.
Smite thee and thy people with the pestilence () = thus total devastation. A pestilence = the vastation of good and truth; here, total devastation. Explained.
A pestilence = the vastation of good and truth. References.
That David chose the pestilence, and that seventy thousand men died of it, = that with the Israelitish and Jewish nation all the truth and good of faith and love would perish...
Pestilence, and death, = plenary consumption, and thus damnation.
Shuns the evil of adultery as the pestilence of the soul, commonwealth, and body.
Pestilence = the consequent consumption.
Famine and pestilence = the defect and consumption of truths.
The evils which are not known to be evils are meant by the pestilence which creepeth in darkness.
Pestilence = the deprivation of spiritual life.
Pestilence = the consumption and deprivation of spiritual life thence. AE 388:20.
Pestilence = the vastation of good and truth.
Pestilences = infections by falsities.
Pestilence (in the Prophets) = evil of life.
